--- revoke_execute_on_function.sql
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION udfscope.f, udfscope.g FROM ROLE udf_reader

    Execute: 7,
    Names:   []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{

        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{

            Name:    "udfscope",
          },
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 48,
            NameEnd: 49,
            Name:    "g",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 60,
      NameEnd: 70,
      Name:    "udf_reader",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION udfscope.f, udfscope.g FROM ROLE udf_reader
